notes: Exact duplicates and substantively equivalent answers receive equal credit; formatting, answer position and opening client quotations do not independently affect scores.

The strongest answers convert Tallgrass requirements into concrete pilots, reconciliations, acceptance checks, ownership and delivery sequencing, while repeated gaps include detailed stitching mechanics, data-view settings, page-view event wiring and operational response commitments.

Universal Editor promises alongside Core Components and editable templates leave implementation assumptions unresolved in several answers; this uncertainty is distinguished from a proven technical incompatibility.

Additional licenses are assessed for explained relevance: conditional stitching, Data Mirror and BI extension entitlements are not inherently defects, while the separate Adobe Analytics dependency in B.6 C lacks a clear need for the requested CJA training.

Specific product assertions about regional immutability, package entitlements, BI limits, learning periods and governance behavior were not independently verified from this panel and are treated as uncertainties rather than established factual errors; no word-limit deductions were applied.
